changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Repair unfinished release-build projections created by the legacy commit path that copied the dbt node name into targetPhysicalName. The immutable visual-authoring input remains the source of truth; published and otherwise terminal history is not changed.
changeSet.sql:
with repairs as ( select e.tenant_id, e.candidate_id, e.id as entry_id, e.target_identifier as legacy_target, visual.targets ->> 0 as recovered_target from modeling_model_release_candidate c join modeling_model_release_candidate_entry e on e.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and e.candidate_id = c.id join modeling_model_implementation_revision ir on ir.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and ir.implementation_id = e.implementation_id and ir.revision = e.implementation_revision and ir.content_checksum = e.implementation_checksum cross join lateral ( select jsonb_path_query_array( ir.inputs_json, '$[*].config.visualImplementation.settings.targetPhysicalName' ) as targets ) visual where c.status in ('DRAFT', 'LOCKED', 'BUILDING', 'BUILD_FAILED') and e.implementation_id is not null and e.implementation_revision is not null and e.implementation_checksum is not null and e.dbt_unique_id is not null and e.target_identifier = split_part(e.dbt_unique_id, '.', 3) and ir.settings_json ->> 'targetPhysicalName' = e.target_identifier and jsonb_array_length(visual.targets) = 1 and visual.targets ->> 0 ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$' and visual.targets ->> 0 <> e.target_identifier ) update modeling_pipeline_run run set target = repairs.recovered_target, last_modified_date = current_timestamp from repairs where run.tenant_id = repairs.tenant_id and run.release_candidate_id = repairs.candidate_id and run.release_candidate_entry_id = repairs.entry_id and run.run_purpose = 'RELEASE_BUILD' and run.target = repairs.legacy_target;
with repairs as ( select e.tenant_id, e.candidate_id, e.id as entry_id, visual.targets ->> 0 as recovered_target from modeling_model_release_candidate c join modeling_model_release_candidate_entry e on e.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and e.candidate_id = c.id join modeling_model_implementation_revision ir on ir.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and ir.implementation_id = e.implementation_id and ir.revision = e.implementation_revision and ir.content_checksum = e.implementation_checksum cross join lateral ( select jsonb_path_query_array( ir.inputs_json, '$[*].config.visualImplementation.settings.targetPhysicalName' ) as targets ) visual where c.status in ('DRAFT', 'LOCKED', 'BUILDING', 'BUILD_FAILED') and e.implementation_id is not null and e.implementation_revision is not null and e.implementation_checksum is not null and e.dbt_unique_id is not null and e.target_identifier = split_part(e.dbt_unique_id, '.', 3) and ir.settings_json ->> 'targetPhysicalName' = e.target_identifier and jsonb_array_length(visual.targets) = 1 and visual.targets ->> 0 ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$' and visual.targets ->> 0 <> e.target_identifier ) update modeling_model_release_candidate_entry entry set target_identifier = repairs.recovered_target from repairs where entry.tenant_id = repairs.tenant_id and entry.candidate_id = repairs.candidate_id and entry.id = repairs.entry_id;
